nameOrigin: Japanese term for a rumbling sound

pokedexEntries.x: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

pokedexEntries.or: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

pokedexEntries.y: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.

pokedexEntries.as: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.

pokedexEntries.su: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro’s Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

pokedexEntries.mo: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent’s movements. It’s eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

pokedexEntries.us: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.

pokedexEntries.um: Pangoro is the type to talk with its fists. It doesn’t say much as it pummels opponents with enough force to send a dump truck flying.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

pokedexEntries.sh: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.
